# ReminderPicker (chat block)

• ReminderPicker(title (static), options? (static), remindBefore? (static), repeatDays? (static))
  - Description: A reminder picker with time chips, a lead-time slider and a repeat stepper.
  - title: What to remind about, e.g. "Review the report".
  - options: Quick time choices; the first is selected. Defaults to today 6 pm and tomorrow 9 am.
    List of maps keys:
    * label - Chip text, e.g. "Today 6 pm".
    * at - Local ISO datetime, e.g. "2026-11-16T18:00".
  - remindBefore: Minutes before the time to remind (0-120). Default 0.
  - repeatDays: Repeat every N days; 0 = never. Default 0.

ReminderPicker(title, options?, remindBefore?, repeatDays?) — a reminder card: when (quick chips + pick a date), how many minutes before (0-120), repeat every N days. title is what to remind about; options = [{label, at}] with at a local ISO datetime ("2026-11-16T18:00"), first is preselected; defaults to today 6 pm / tomorrow 9 am. Use it when the user asks to be reminded. Events: set_reminder {title, at, remindBefore, repeatDays}, add_to_calendar {same}, dismiss_reminder {}. Example: card = ReminderPicker("Review the report", [{label: "Today 6 pm", at: "2026-11-16T18:00"}, {label: "Tomorrow 9 am", at: "2026-11-17T09:00"}], 45, 2)
